intuition: A row can satisfy gather when its remaining capacity reaches k, while scatter needs the total remaining capacity in a row prefix.

brute_force.approach: Scan rows from zero for every request and track occupied seats directly.

optimal.approach: A segment tree stores both maximum free seats in one row and total free seats in a range; consume seats from the earliest eligible rows.
optimal.time: gather O(log n), scatter O((r + 1) log n), where r is the number of touched rows

edge_cases: gather requires consecutive seats within a single row.
scatter checks prefix capacity before changing any row.
